name: Synpolydactyly Type 3

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for Synpolydactyly

criteria.description: Presence of syndactyly combined with polydactyly affecting hands and/or feet
Identification of HOXD13 gene mutation, typically polyalanine repeat expansion
Radiographic evidence of fused and duplicated phalanges consistent with synpolydactyly
Positive family history of autosomal dominant inheritance pattern

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic clinical features (syndactyly with polydactyly) plus either genetic confirmation of HOXD13 mutation or radiographic evidence of phalangeal anomalies
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is critical for definitive diagnosis due to phenotypic overlap with other polydactyly syndromes.

mild hand or foot movement problems

abnormal nail growth on fingers or toes

laboratory: Genetic testing revealing HOXD13 polyalanine repeat expansion mutation
imaging: X-rays showing fused and duplicated phalanges
Radiographs demonstrating syndactyly and polydactyly patterns
genetic: Autosomal dominant mutations in HOXD13 gene

Presence of developmental delay or neurological deficits
